name: application-13
title: Agent start screen
description: A Wrenfield start screen for an agent app: recent sessions down the side, one prompt box with attachments, a model key and a mode key, suggested tasks that fill the prompt when picked and the latest runs with their state, where a run that waits is allowed or denied in place. Behind it a field of mono glyphs shows in a soft lens that follows the pointer, and a press on empty space sends a ripple through it. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.
